name: Galaxy Grand 2

Launch.Announced / released: December 2013 and January 2014 (India), February and March 2014 (Philippines)
Launch.Successor: Samsung Galaxy Grand Max, Samsung Galaxy Grand Prime

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 4.3 "Jelly Bean", with TouchWiz Nature UX, Current: Android 4.4 "KitKat" (version 4.4.2) (last supported version), Unofficial: Up to Android 9, Lineage OS 16
Platform.CPU: 1.2 GHz quad-core processor , ARM Cortex-A7 Snapdragon 400 MSM8226

Cameras.Rear camera: 8 MP 1080p Full HD video recording @ 30 fps with auto-focus; self-timer; panorama; smile shot; face detection; stop motion

Connectivity.Connectivity: Bluetooth 4.0, micro-USB 2.0, Wi-Fi (IEEE 802.11, 802.11a/b/g/n), Wi-Fi Direct, FM radio with Radio Data System, RDS, A-GPS and GLONASS
